headline: The fastest mount in Palworld
title: Fastest Mount in Palworld | Jetragon Still Rules | Palworld Guide
video_script: What's the fastest mount in Palworld one point zero? Guides still name Jetragon, with a sprint speed of around three thousand three hundred. No other mount comes close. In one point zero, Jetragon moved to the Sunreach sky islands and is now a level seventy Alpha, so it's an endgame catch. It's weak to Ice, so bring Ice Pals and plenty of strong spheres. And remember, you need its saddle before you can ride it. Got your Jetragon yet? Comment below!
description: The fastest mount in Palworld 1.0 is still Jetragon (sprint speed around 3,300), now a level 70 Alpha on the Sunreach sky islands. Weak to Ice; needs its saddle.
